    """
    # Net income (loss) for FY24 (in millions of USD)
    # Source: IFC 2024 Annual Report Financials, Consolidated Statements of Operations (Page 64)

    # Total assets as of June 30, 2024 (in millions of USD)
    # Source: IFC 2024 Annual Report Financials, Consolidated Balance Sheets (Page 63)

    def net_income_full(self) -> float:
        """Returns the net income in full USD dollars."""
        return self.net_income_millions * 1_000_000.0

    @property
    def total_assets_full(self) -> float:
        """Returns the total assets in full USD dollars."""
        return self.total_assets_millions * 1_000_000.0

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return (
            f"IFC FY24 Financial Figures:\n"
            f"  Net Income:   ${self.net_income_millions:,.1f} Million (${self.net_income_full:,.2f})\n"
